title: Jupyter Blog
description: The Project Jupyter blog: news, releases, and community stories, archived from blog.jupyter.org.
intro: News, release announcements, and community stories from [Project Jupyter](https://jupyter.org), 2015–present. This site is a static archive of the publication that lived at blog.jupyter.org, first on Ghost and then on Medium; every post below is preserved with its original images, author, and date.
